name: The Faces of Threshold

objectives.desc: Meet the smith at the Forges
Meet the docent in the Reading Hall
Meet the prior at the Nine Chapels
Meet the captain at the Muster Gate
Meet the chef in the Granary Kitchens
Meet the alchemist at the Alembics
Meet Master Ekwe on the Sand

desc: Talk to the eight trades of Threshold, one per district. Each vendor charges strangers half again the price until spoken to. Reward: 60 gold, 50 level XP, 4 favor, 25 Scouting XP, and a crate of iron scrap, raw meat, common herb, spring water and mendroot.

name: A Taste of Everything

objectives.desc: Cook a dish on the Cooking Stove in the Granary Kitchens
Bottle a brew at the Alembics
Add 3 species to your bestiary (the Cages)
Inscribe a new spell at the Reading Hall’s Spellcrafting Table
Learn a miracle at the Nine Chapels (Spellcrafting Table, Divine tab)

desc: Use each open craft once with the Warden’s crate: smelt an ingot, cook a dish, bottle a brew, add 3 bestiary species, defeat 5 monsters, inscribe a new spell, learn a miracle. Reward: 250 gold, 75 level XP. Requires The Faces of Threshold.

name: The First Ascent

objectives.desc: Recover the toll stamp from the collector

desc: Take the toll stamp from the Toll Collector on floor 1. Clear the Vermin Hall, find the clerk’s daybook in the Archive and the office key at reception, then visit the offices in the order the daybook gives. Reward: 350 gold, 100 level XP, 1 favor.

name: Shore Up the Gate
desc: Bring the steward on floor 11 twenty hardwood and fifteen iron scrap. The yard has timber; the road’s raiders drop scrap. Reward: 200 gold, 150 level XP.

name: Arm the Wall
desc: Kill ten raiders on the road and bring four iron ingots. Turning it in opens the way up onto the wall, where the wave comes. Reward: 250 gold, 200 level XP.

name: Sign With the Merchants
desc: Accepting this picks the merchants for the run; the other three berths stop offering theirs. Win 8 crates on the roadstead: defend the convoy and sell what is left at port. Reward: 300 gold, 250 level XP.

name: Sign On With the Pirates
desc: Accepting this picks the pirates for the run; the other three berths stop offering theirs. Win 8 crates on the roadstead by seizing them from the convoy. Reward: 300 gold, 250 level XP.

name: Take Out a Letter of Marque
desc: Accepting this picks the privateers for the run; the other three berths stop offering theirs. Win 8 crates on the roadstead by recovering them from the pirates. Reward: 300 gold, 250 level XP.

name: Enlist With the Navy
desc: Accepting this picks the navy for the run; the other three berths stop offering theirs. Win 8 crates on the roadstead by escorting the convoy past the sea monsters. Reward: 300 gold, 250 level XP.

name: Clear the Closed Port
desc: Buy a Port Clearance from the harbor master at the Last Port on floor 13. Turned in, the warden of the closed port and his escorts start the floor-14 fight Flat-Footed. Reward: 200 gold, 300 level XP.

name: Forge a Signal
desc: Take the signal books off 12 marines. Turned in, the treasure galleon’s crew starts the floor-14 fight Surprised. Reward: 200 gold, 300 level XP.

name: Renew the Letter
desc: Kill 12 pirate gunners as proof of service. Turned in, the pirate king’s crew starts the floor-14 fight Flat-Footed. Reward: 200 gold, 300 level XP.

name: Bait a Lure
desc: Kill 12 deep serpents to bait the lure. Turned in, the sea beast and its brood start the floor-14 fight Surprised. Reward: 200 gold, 300 level XP.
